reviews.text:
This was and is a very kind and skilled veterinarian.

He saved my dog; she had a very high fever and was very sick.

But after a course of treatment, she was fortunately better again 3 days later.
I’ve been very happy with the care my cat gets from Dr Chris. He and his team are always very responsive on emails whenever I’ve had questions or concerns about my cat.
Great emergency vet. Our cat was seen by the nicest doctor right away.
My cat could be helped quickly on Sunday.

A really good practice! If you have problems over the weekend, you can still come here for good care, and they treat the animals with great love.

People with a heart for the animals and their practice!
A very friendly vet

Our cat Loki swallowed a rubber band and we had to come here at 10PM on a public holiday. The vet and assistant were very friendly and helped Loki quickly to puke out the band. Loki was a bit sleepy from the medication but that wore off very quickly and he was fully recovered the next morning :)

I urgently needed help for my dog, but had nowhere to turn. Dr. Chris Polanen helped me then. He is a very professional, helpful, and dedicated veterinarian. I am very grateful to him for the good care and help.
If you are looking for a veterinary practice that works with love for animals, then you have come to the right place.

After a bad experience at another veterinary practice, I ended up at Practice Polanen. I consider this the best veterinary practice. Especially because they are all very kind and helpful. I come here with my 2 rats. I will always stay with this practice. No other for me!

A truly wonderful veterinarian with a clear passion for animals. I ended up here after my regular vet was acquired by Evidensia (a private equity firm), which prioritized the shareholders.
My two cats recently had dental work done by Mr. Polanen and have visibly improved. It's also worth mentioning that Mr. Polanen is a good writer.

Dr. Polanen and his team are always incredibly helpful. We have two cats, one of whom has a weakened immune system and has unfortunately suffered from severe infections over the past few months, and we have always received immediate help whenever needed. We are immensely grateful to have a good, kind, and expert veterinarian and team in our neighborhood. Thank you so much for your excellent care!

Doctor Chris, is special... my dog likes him very much and therefore me too! He has a calm, confident energy that helps me and my dog to feel ok at the doctor's office! He's also very kind and patient. Always available for tips and reassurance!! His stuff is super nice as well! And the practice it's always so clean! I would recommend him to my friends!
Actually, I do already 😅
Thanks doctor from us!

We chose this clinic to spay our dog because of the many positive reviews, but our experience was very different.

First, they administered anesthesia without even weighing her. The surgery itself seemed okay, but on the seventh day, the wound became infected. We made an urgent appointment, but when we came the doctor had already left for the day and didn't bother to examine her. He just prescribed ointment and medication over the phone.

I don't understand how this level of service has so many good reviews. We cannot recommend this place.
Super nice vet, very sweet to our Jojo who was staying with us.
Most carrying, friendly and efficient vet I’ve been to.
Very emphatic & good veterinarian, great team, recommended ❤️

I've always received good service here. The prices are good and always cheaper than, for example, Ranzijn. Polanen is a veterinarian with a good heart. That goes for his assistants as well, by the way!

Normally, I don’t write reviews, but I feel like I have to share my experience. Every time I go in for a simple vaccination, I end up being charged for something overpriced that I didn’t expect. They told me the price was “per pill,” but the total ended up being far higher than what seemed fair. I have two cats, and they promised a discount, but instead of treating them together, they keep calling me to bring them in one at a time—so I end up paying double the fees.

On top of that, the staff has been consistently rude and dismissive when I ask questions or express concern about the charges. I expected better treatment, especially from a place that’s supposed to care for animals and their owners. Very disappointing experience overall.
Excellent service, our vet was super kind, helpful and clear during the diagnostic and treatment

So friendly, decisive, and understanding.
Great veterinary practice!

Today was our first time at the Doctor's with our cat. I am very satisfied. The Doctor was very kind, both to us and to our cat. I feel we received professional and kind care. Thank you very much. I have been looking for a veterinarian like this for a long time.
Great vet and friendly help from the ladies behind the counter

Everyone is so nice and so helpful and understanding! Easy to get an appointment, very responsive. I even called outside the hours (late in the evening) once cause of my kitten infection and Chris was very helpful, and checked her out next day! Super super happy to have this vet clinic so close by!
Really a top vet!

I only have good words about the vet and the staff members. Friendly, caring, supportive and knowledgeable.
Thank you for looking after  my kitten!
Good veterinarian with reasonable prices.
